service.description:
One search over the authorized Mantle documents in an index: parties, products, facilities, orders, invoices, shipments, assets, communications, and wiki pages.
The document types are those whose primary entity the user may view. When the user has an organization filter (MANTLE_USER_ORG or MANTLE_ACTIVE_ORG, whichever of the filter sets on a party find names, MANTLE_USER_ORG first, as get#RecordLinkInfo) each type is limited to records of its organizations, by the type's organization fields: the user's organizations (filterOrgIds) for MANTLE_USER_ORG, and for MANTLE_ACTIVE_ORG the active organization, or all of the user's organizations when none is active (the set's applyCond leaves it off then, but the user still has the filter here); and to records that name the user: a project, task, event or request the user's party owns, filed or is a party to (or one of those organizations is), and a communication event the user's party is from, to or a party to, or a post of a mailbox the user may read. A type with neither is left out under the limit, except wiki pages. A party that is a personal contact (privateOwnerUserId) shows only to its owner, with or without a limit. A mailbox post (contactListId of a MAILBOX list) shows, with or without a limit, to those who may read the mailbox (its members; any user for a public mailbox that is not a help mailbox) and otherwise only to the parties it is from, to or a recipient of. A wiki page shows, with or without a limit and for every user, by the wiki's view rule (org.moqui.impl.WikiServices.get#WikiViewScope, the rule of get#WikiPageAccess that get#RecordLinkInfo asks): its space has no restrictView Y or the user has a WikiSpaceUser row with allowView or allowAdmin Y for it, and the page has no restrictView Y or the user has a WikiPageUser row with allowView Y for it; the ADMIN group sees every page. The limit is a trusted filter: it applies before ranking, totals, facets and highlights, and the query cannot widen it. Each result is checked against the entity database before it is returned.
mode is lexical (the default; words match as prefixes, quotes make a phrase, field:value searches a field), autocomplete (the title starts with the text, or each word starts a title word), semantic, or hybrid; semantic and hybrid need those search capabilities. near ({terms, distance}) needs the proximity capability. facets may name entityType (counts by document type) and category (counts by the type's category, with one entityType).

parameter.name: entityType
parameter.description: A DataDocument id, or a comma-separated list of them.

parameter.name: filters
parameter.description: Field name to a value, or to a list of values.
